title: Access phases
statement: An access phase is either an outward walk with a phase $j\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, a memory operation, or a return walk carrying a bit $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and a phase $j\in\{0,1,2\}$.
